description: This file is a script to support running vitest test specifications with environment setup, lock management, and cleanup. It manages test execution, lock acquisition, temp file cleanup, and process exit handling for testing workflows.

methods.name: releaseLockOnce
methods.description: Ensures the lock is released only once during the script execution.

methods.name: cleanupVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Removes temporary include files for a given test spec if present.

methods.name: runVitestSpec
methods.description: Executes a vitest test specification, including environment setup and cleanup, returning a promise with the result.

methods.name: createRootVitestRunSpec
methods.description: Creates a default test spec configuration based on command-line arguments and environment.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that orchestrates the test run process, handling multiple specs and process control.
